messages:
Alice Kim: opened PR #842 to add SDK migration notes + small Python/JS snippets for v1.0. Targeting docs release window on Thursday. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

docs-bot: Preview build queued -> https://deploy-preview-842--redwood-docs.netlify.app/sdk/migration (checks: lint, build, links)

Marco Ruiz: Quick style requests before full review: always use `Redwood SDK` (capital R), prefer specific model names instead of generic 'AI model', and stick to sentence case headings rather than title case.

Priya Nair: Couple of voice/terminology points: avoid contractions ("you'll" -> "you will"), use `LLM` uppercase, and keep examples minimal and copy-pasteable.

Tom Becker: lintrunner picked up `llm` and `api key` casing in a few places. Also flagged one heading for imperative phrasing.

lintrunner: Lint results: terminology warnings (5), heading-style suggestion (1). See /checks/lint for details.

Alice Kim: I will patch the casing + fenced code blocks now. Can Marco or Priya re-check the migration snippets after I push? We need 2 approvals to merge.

deploy-bot: Docs build triggered · staging preview will update when build finishes.

Alice Kim: Pushed commit 4: fixed LLM/API casing, added fenced code blocks with language tags, and condensed migration example. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842/files

Marco Ruiz: Reviewing. Migration section needs a tiny before/after example and a one-line callout about changed retry semantics. Suggest this Python snippet:

```python
# old (v0.9)
resp = client.complete(prompt)

# new (v1.0)
resp = client.responses.create(prompt=prompt)
```

Priya Nair: That snippet is great. Add H2 heading "Migration notes" (sentence case) and a short bullet that links to breaking-changes.md. Also, move the retry callout right under the snippet so it's visible.

Tom Becker: Nit: our docs generally use sentence case headings, not imperative. Marco, thanks for aligning those.

lintrunner: Re-run lint: casing issues cleared. Remaining suggestion: prefer sentence case for that one H2.

Marco Ruiz: Adjusted heading to sentence case and left one inline comment. Approved from me :+1:

Priya Nair: Approved (one tiny optional placement nit for the callout). No blockers.

Alice Kim: Thanks — merging after final CI. Aiming to merge before 10:00 PT to avoid code freeze at noon.

deploy-bot: All checks passed · preview published: https://deploy-preview-842--redwood-docs.netlify.app (✅)

Alice Kim: Merged. Thanks for the quick reviews! :tada:

Marco Ruiz: Nice turnaround.

Priya Nair: I'll open a follow-up PR to adjust the retry placement per the optional nit.

docs-bot: Thread archived for records.
